---
title: 'Not reported — Other descriptive statistics'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Registrations per 1,000, full sample

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(ever_treated) |>
  summarise(
    mean_y   = mean(n_installations_per_1000),
    sd_y     = sd(n_installations_per_1000),
    median_y = median(n_installations_per_1000),
    n_obs    = n()
  )
```

## Registrations per 1,000 by quarter of the year

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(qtr = quarters(date)) |>
  summarise(mean_y = mean(n_installations_per_1000))
```
